questions.prompt: A dataset combines audio, tables, and free text, but many entries contain unreliable claims. Which pair of challenges is present?
options: Only velocity and dimensionality reduction.
Only volume and velocity.
Only storage compression and class imbalance.
Variety and veracity.
questions.explanationZh: 音频、表格、文本体现形式多样性；不可靠内容体现数据真实性/可信度问题。题目没有给出规模、流速或类别比例，不能凭空推断。
distractorsZh: 没有描述流速，也没有指定降维任务。
题目没有强调数据规模或到达速度。
没有给出压缩率或类别分布。

questions.prompt: Which association correctly distinguishes Boolean vectors, count vectors, and learned embeddings?
options: Boolean vectors indicate presence; count vectors indicate frequency; embeddings encode learned contextual relationships.
Embeddings are simply the document word-count column renamed.
All three representations must have exactly one nonzero coordinate.
Boolean vectors preserve exact word order; counts encode sentence syntax.
questions.explanationZh: 第13页依次强调 presence、frequency、context。第16页词嵌入是d维语义向量，可用word2vec等标准资源或训练领域/情感嵌入；它不是TF-IDF加一个固定列。
distractorsZh: 词嵌入由学习目标产生，不等同计数。
多热向量与稠密嵌入均不满足唯一非零。
布尔和计数词袋通常都丢失词序。

refs.reasonZh: 三种表征分别保留什么
三种表征分别保留什么

questions.prompt: A vocabulary is [red, blue, car, bus]. What Boolean vector represents the document “red car car”?
questions.explanationZh: 布尔表示只记录每个词是否出现，所以car出现两次仍为1。维度等于词表大小4；文档可有多个1，严格说是multi-hot，而单词one-hot只有一个1。
distractorsZh: 按句长设维度破坏了固定词表坐标。
这是词频向量而非布尔向量。
遗漏了red。

questions.prompt: With N documents and document frequency df(t), which weighting expression gives rarer terms a larger IDF?
options: log(0) for every absent term, retained as a finite weight.
(1 + log tf(t,d)) × log(df(t) / N).
(1 + log tf(t,d)) × log(N / df(t)), when tf(t,d) > 0.
tf(t,d) × N, with no document-frequency term.
questions.explanationZh: 第15页写log(n/N)但未清晰定义符号，第32页明确采用log10(N/df_t)。应先定义N总文档数、df出现该词的文档数；非零TF取1+log tf，未出现项记0而不是计算log0。原始词频、TF-IDF都可用于词袋，词袋不必“基于TF-IDF”。
distractorsZh: log0未定义，必须分段处理。
该比值会使更罕见词得到更负的值。
忽略了跨文档稀有程度。

questions.prompt: A term–document matrix has terms as rows and documents as columns. What does entry X[i,j]=5 mean in a raw-count matrix?
options: Term i is absent from document j but has vocabulary index 5.
Document i contains five distinct terms from column j.
Term i occurs five times in document j.
Document j has probability 5 of belonging to class i.
questions.explanationZh: 行确定词项，列确定文档，元素记录该词在该文档中的出现次数。计数无需在一列内归一化为概率。
distractorsZh: 正计数意味着出现，而非缺席。
交换了行列并把出现次数误当不同词数。
概率不能为5，而且该表不是类别后验表。

questions.prompt: Using IDF(t)=log(N/df(t)), what IDF does a term receive if it occurs in every one of the N documents?
options: Zero.
N.
One, regardless of log base.
An undefined value caused by division by zero.
questions.explanationZh: df(t)=N，因此log(N/N)=log1=0。广泛出现的词在该IDF定义下没有跨文档区分力；某些软件会加入平滑或常数，必须按明确公式作答。
distractorsZh: N是文档数而非对数结果。
log1为0，不是1。
分母为N，不是0。

refs.reasonZh: IDF降低无区分力高频词的权重
IDF降低无区分力高频词的权重
IDF降低无区分力高频词的权重

questions.prompt: Why might happy and sad be closer in a general embedding space than in a sentiment-oriented space?
options: CBOW predicts surrounding words from a single target, as its standard definition.
Opposite sentiment implies the words can never share contexts.
They may occur in similar contexts, while a sentiment objective emphasizes opposite polarity.
A word pair has the same distance in every trained embedding space.
questions.explanationZh: 第16页用happy/sad说明上下文相似与任务极性不同：普通嵌入可能接近，情感嵌入需区分。该页把CBOW方向写反；以第110页为准，CBOW上下文→中心词，Skip-gram中心词→上下文。
distractorsZh: 这是Skip-gram方向，非标准CBOW。
反义词常在相似语法语境出现。
训练语料、目标和参数都会改变空间。

refs.reasonZh: 领域目标改变happy/sad关系与CBOW纠错
领域目标改变happy/sad关系与CBOW纠错

questions.prompt: In a term-document vector-space model, what determines the number of dimensions?
options: The number of classes predicted by the classifier.
The vocabulary size |V|.
The number of words in the current query only.
Exactly three dimensions for every possible text collection.
questions.explanationZh: 第20页词项为轴、文档为点/向量。示意依次|V|=1、2、3；网页检索可能有数千万维，不能把画图维度当实际维度。
distractorsZh: 类别数与输入词空间维度不同。
词表不是当前查询的长度。
三维图只是教学投影。

questions.prompt: Why can a learned semantic representation consider “car” and “automobile” similar even though the strings differ?
options: Semantic similarity is determined entirely by the number of characters.
Cosine similarity first requires the two strings to have exactly the same spelling.
Any two words with different IDs must have cosine similarity zero in every representation.
Learned coordinates can capture related usage instead of assigning unrelated words orthogonal identity axes.
questions.explanationZh: 词项身份编码与语义嵌入不同。one-hot的不同词坐标正交；学习型表示可利用相近语境让不同词接近，但并不保证所有近邻都可互换。
distractorsZh: 字符长度不能决定语义。
向量相似度不要求拼写相同。
这一结论只适用于特定正交编码，不适用于所有表示。

refs.reasonZh: 语义关系与词项独立轴的区别

questions.prompt: Why can Euclidean distance rank a long document poorly even when its term proportions resemble the query?
options: Identical proportions force identical raw counts.
Euclidean distance is undefined for all text vectors.
Cosine similarity compares only the number of documents.
Its vector magnitude can be much larger despite a similar direction.
questions.explanationZh: 第22页q与d2方向相近但距离较大，坐标轴以GOSSIP与JEALOUS作示意。距离同时受长度和方向影响，不能把“可能不合适”写成所有文本任务禁用欧氏距离。
distractorsZh: 比例相同不意味着总量相同。
数值化后欧氏距离可以正常定义。
余弦比较向量夹角。

refs.reasonZh: 欧氏距离受文档长度影响

questions.prompt: For a nonzero raw-count vector d, what happens when its document is concatenated with itself?
options: The new vector is -d, so cosine similarity is -1.
Both vectors become zero after concatenation.
The new vector is 2d, with cosine similarity 1 to d but generally nonzero Euclidean distance.
The Euclidean distance is always zero because the topic is unchanged.
questions.explanationZh: 按原始词频或固定IDF的线性加权，复制后d′=2d，夹角0，cos=1，欧氏距离为||d||。若用1+log tf，对数变换不再严格保持所有坐标等比例；第23页直觉必须注明表征假设。
distractorsZh: 复制不会把符号取反。
复制不会清空词频。
语义相同不代表数值向量相同。

refs.reasonZh: 文档复制后的角度与距离

questions.prompt: What is the cosine similarity of q=(1,1) and d=(2,0)?
options: 1/√2, approximately 0.707.
1, because both vectors contain a positive coordinate.
0, because the second coordinates differ.
2, because the unnormalized dot product is 2.
questions.explanationZh: cos(q,d)=(q·d)/(||q||||d||)=2/(√2×2)=1/√2。点积与归一化是第24页公式的两个部分；零向量需要另定处理规则。
distractorsZh: 存在正值不能推出完全同向。
余弦不是逐格相等检测。
漏除了范数。

questions.prompt: After both vectors are normalized to unit length, how is cosine similarity computed?
options: As their dot product.
As the sum of their coordinate-wise absolute differences.
As the product of their original document lengths.
As the number of nonzero terms divided by the class count.
questions.explanationZh: 第24页给出归一化后cos(q,d)=Σq_i d_i。第32页比较欧氏距离√Σ(x_i−y_i)²和TF-IDF余弦。补充推论：单位向量有||q−d||²=2−2cos(q,d)，此时二者排序相容；不同输入处理不可混比。
distractorsZh: 那是L1距离，不是余弦。
已经移除了原长度影响。
这不是本页任何相似度定义。

refs.reasonZh: 单位向量上的余弦及距离
单位向量上的余弦及距离

questions.prompt: Which list consists of methods for reducing a high-dimensional representation?
options: More duplicated columns, more zero rows, and longer documents.
Feature selection, truncated SVD, and random projections.
Naive Bayes, majority voting, and one-versus-all.
Token labels, class names, and confusion matrices.
questions.explanationZh: 第25页问题是稀疏、矩阵过大/过高，列出feature selection、TSVD、random projections。它们是不同路线，不是必须顺序执行的三步。
distractorsZh: 通常扩大而非压缩表示。
属于分类/组合策略而非此处三项。
不是降维算法列表。

refs.reasonZh: 稀疏高维问题和三个降维路线

questions.prompt: Which sequence describes truncated singular-value decomposition?
options: Factorize the matrix, retain the largest k singular components, and reconstruct a rank-k approximation.
Discard the largest singular values before factorization.
Sort documents alphabetically and retain the first rows.
Assign labels, fit an SVM, and delete its support vectors.
questions.explanationZh: 第26页写1 Factorize，2 Discard some singular values，3 Rebuild，并画X=UΣVᵀ。截断通常保留最大k个奇异值及对应方向，删除较小分量。
distractorsZh: 必须先分解；通常保留主导分量。
按名称排序与低秩近似无关。
这不是矩阵分解流程。

questions.prompt: If X has shape m×n, what shape does the reconstructed rank-k matrix U_k Σ_k V_k^T have?
options: m×n; its rank is reduced even though the reconstruction has the original shape.
m×k, identical to the left factor U_k.
n×m because the product always transposes X.
k×k in every case.
questions.explanationZh: 原矩阵重建仍m×n；降维坐标可单独取Σ_kV_kᵀ（k×n）或U_kᵀX。不要把“低秩重建”和“低维坐标”混成一个对象。第27页3D→2D是坐标投影直觉。
distractorsZh: 忽略了后续因子。
因子乘积重建X而非Xᵀ。
k×k是Σ_k的形状。

questions.prompt: What is a valid expectation about distances and angles after a truncated-SVD projection?
options: Any one-dimensional projection preserves all pairwise distances exactly.
Every discarded direction is guaranteed to contain only noise.
Every pairwise angle must remain mathematically identical for every retained rank.
Important structure may be approximately retained, but every pairwise distance and angle need not remain identical.
questions.explanationZh: 截断丢弃部分方向，通常会改变距离和角度。保留主要结构是近似目标，不是对所有点、所有秩的等距保证。
distractorsZh: 一般高维点集无法如此无损压到一维。
较小奇异方向仍可能含任务信号。
截断可能改变角度。

refs.reasonZh: 低维几何只可能近似保留

questions.prompt: In a truncated-SVD approximation, what tradeoff generally arises when fewer singular components are retained?
options: The number of retained components has no effect on approximation capacity.
The reconstructed matrix must gain rank.
Lower storage/computation can come at the cost of greater reconstruction error.
All details are preserved exactly for every input matrix.
questions.explanationZh: 保留较少成分提供更紧凑的表示，但通常丢失更多细节。对固定矩阵，增加截断秩可使最佳低秩近似误差非增；这不等于下游任务分数必定上升。
distractorsZh: k正是近似容量的重要控制量。
较少保留成分不能提高秩上界。
被丢弃的非零成分会产生重建误差。

questions.prompt: A two-dimensional projection places several words close together. What is the most careful interpretation?
options: Every pair must be interchangeable in every sentence.
Every axis must correspond to a named human emotion.
All original high-dimensional distances must be reproduced exactly.
They may share structure in the learned representation, but projection proximity alone does not prove exact synonymy.
questions.explanationZh: 低维图是检查表示结构的线索。近邻可能来自共现、主题或其他关系，投影也可能失真，因此不能仅凭图判断严格同义。
distractorsZh: 相近不代表任何语境下可互换。
分布式维度不必有明确人类名称。
低维投影一般会丢失几何信息。

refs.reasonZh: 可视化邻近不等于语义定论

questions.prompt: A system is trained on documents labeled finance, sport, or science. What is its supervised classification task for a new document?
options: Discover clusters without using the provided labels.
Output a raw word-count matrix instead of a category.
Assign one of the learned category labels from its features.
Create a unique new label for every document by definition.
questions.explanationZh: 有监督分类通过带标签样本学习特征到类别的映射。向量化是输入处理，聚类是不同的无监督设置。
distractorsZh: 这描述聚类而非利用已知标签的分类。
词频矩阵是表示，不是类别预测。
类别通常在训练任务中给定。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: Two documents in class C have vectors (1,3) and (3,5). What is their arithmetic-mean centroid?
options: (3,5), because the longest document defines the center.
(1,3), because a centroid must be an observed point.
questions.explanationZh: μ(C)=1/|D_C| Σv(d)，所以平均为(2,4)。用指定距离或相似度选择最近质心；质心不必是实际样本，归一化的先后也必须一致。
distractorsZh: 定义不是选择最长向量。
这是总和，漏除样本数2。
这是medoid可能满足的限制，不是均值质心。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What objective does least-squares fitting minimize?
options: Counting only points exactly on a support margin.
Selecting the vocabulary item with the highest document frequency.
Reducing squared prediction residuals.
Maximizing the number of unlabeled clusters.
questions.explanationZh: 最小二乘最小化平方残差和，例如Σ(y_i−ŷ_i)²。它强调预测误差的大小，不等同聚类数、边界支持点数量或词频。
distractorsZh: 这是另一种间隔视角。
词频选择不是最小二乘定义。
聚类数不是回归残差目标。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What is the main aim of a discriminant projection for classification?
options: The requirement to use only one training example in total.
A rule that replaces every class with a random label.
A representation or projection that helps separate classes.
A guarantee that all original coordinates are preserved exactly.
questions.explanationZh: 判别投影寻找对类别区分有用的方向或表示；它可以牺牲无关变化，不能保证原坐标和所有距离原样保留。
distractorsZh: 图明显含多个类别样本。
标签随机化不在图中。
有判别意义的投影不等于无损保留坐标。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What role do prototypes play in a prototype-based classifier?
options: They are always the two observations closest to an SVM boundary.
They are padding tokens added at sentence boundaries.
They provide reference representatives against which samples can be compared.
They encode the exact posterior probability of every sample.
questions.explanationZh: 原型是类别或局部结构的代表，用于和新样本比较。原型不必是SVM支持向量，也不天然携带后验概率。
distractorsZh: 与第37页支持向量视角不同。
本节是分类几何不是文本卷积。
图没有提供概率数值。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: Which observations chiefly determine a hard-margin SVM separator in the support-vector view?
options: The observations on the closest margin boundaries.
Every possible unseen observation equally, before it is observed.
Only the observations farthest from every class boundary.
Only the class names and no feature vectors.
questions.explanationZh: 第37页新增分隔带和贴近带边界的点；第52–53页再正式定义支持向量。关注难分的边界样本，而不是任意两个质心。
distractorsZh: 不能使用尚未观测的特征。
最远点通常不决定间隔。
边界由带标签向量确定。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: What is the key concern of the receiver-operating-characteristics perspective?
options: How sensitivity and false-positive behavior change with the decision threshold.
How many dimensions a document vocabulary contains.
Whether a word has a noun or verb tag.
Whether training and test documents share the same filename.
questions.explanationZh: 第38页强调Receiver operating characteristics并改变决策边界示意；它并未直接画完整ROC曲线。补充标准读法：TPR=TP/(TP+FN)，FPR=FP/(FP+TN)，阈值改变产生权衡；不可把FPR误作1−precision。
distractorsZh: 这是表征维度问题。
这是词性标注任务。
文件名不是ROC统计定义。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

refs.reasonZh: ROC视角的阈值与错误权衡

questions.prompt: How does a probabilistic classification viewpoint represent class-dependent feature patterns?
options: An assertion that probability and Euclidean distance are identical.
A view of classes as distributions rather than only geometric separators.
A proof that all classes have equal prior probability.
A claim that every point belongs to a separate class.
questions.explanationZh: 概率模型用类别条件分布或似然P(x|c)描述特征规律，再可结合先验求P(c|x)。似然、后验和几何距离不能混为一谈。
distractorsZh: 二者定义不同。
先验需要由假设或数据给出。
轮廓恰好分组多点。

terms.zh: 质心分类与六种分类视角

questions.prompt: Which class does a MAP classifier select for an observed feature vector x?
options: The class whose label is alphabetically first.
The class maximizing P(x) alone.
The class minimizing its prior regardless of x.
The class c maximizing P(c | x).
questions.explanationZh: MAP即maximum a posteriori，最大后验类别。输入d=(x1,…,xn)，输出argmax_c P(c|x)。
distractorsZh: 字母顺序无统计依据。
P(x)不随候选类别改变。
先验只是后验的一部分，非最小化目标。

terms.zh: 朴素贝叶斯推断与平滑

questions.prompt: Why can P(x) be omitted when comparing candidate classes for the same instance?
options: It is equal to the class prior.
It is the same positive normalization factor for every candidate class.
It is always exactly one.
It changes sign whenever the predicted class changes.
questions.explanationZh: P(c|x)=P(x|c)P(c)/P(x)。对同一x且P(x)>0，分母不影响argmax；得到unnormalized scores不等于完整归一化概率。
distractorsZh: 证据与先验不是同一个量。
证据概率一般不是1。
概率不会按类别改变符号。

terms.zh: 朴素贝叶斯推断与平滑

refs.reasonZh: 贝叶斯分母为何能省略

questions.prompt: What independence assumption produces the Naive Bayes product over features?
options: Features are independent of the class itself.
All documents have identical feature vectors.
Classes are conditionally independent given each individual character.
Features are conditionally independent given the class.
questions.explanationZh: P(x1,…,xn|c)≈∏P(xi|c)。这是假定给定c后独立，不是无条件独立，更不是xi与c无关。第41页星形图将类别连到各特征。
distractorsZh: 若特征与类都无关，分类信息会丢失；这非朴素假设。
不要求所有输入相同。
本页没有该类别间假设。

terms.zh: 朴素贝叶斯推断与平滑

refs.reasonZh: 朴素假设是给定类别的条件独立

questions.prompt: If 30 of 100 training instances belong to class C, what is the maximum-likelihood estimate of its class prior?
options: P(C)=1/100 regardless of the class count.
questions.explanationZh: 第41页先验估计N(C=c)/N=30/100。训练集中类别比例与测试环境可能不同，此处只考讲义估计式。
distractorsZh: 比值方向倒置且大于1。
计数尚未归一化。
忽略该类样本数。

terms.zh: 朴素贝叶斯推断与平滑

questions.prompt: A categorical feature has four possible values. In class C there are ten instances, and a value appears twice. What is its add-one estimate?
questions.explanationZh: 讲义公式(N(X_i=x_i,C=c)+1)/(N(C=c)+k)，此处k为该特征可能取值数4，故(2+1)/(10+4)。不要把此k误作kNN的邻居数，也不能一概把分母套成词表大小。
distractorsZh: 分母须加全部四种值的伪计数。
遗漏类内样本总数。
这是未平滑估计。

terms.zh: 朴素贝叶斯推断与平滑

questions.prompt: For two classes with priors 0.6 and 0.4 and feature-likelihood products 0.1 and 0.2, which class has the larger MAP score?
options: They tie, because both have two numbers in the product.
The first class, because it has the larger prior alone.

The position is always the same as the token's dictionary meaning.
questions.explanationZh: 同一组词的不同次序可产生不同意义。位置表示为注意力提供顺序线索；倒排索引记录词项出现位置也说明仅知道“出现过”还不够。
distractorsZh: 变长序列同样需要顺序信息。
交换主客体等词序会改变意义。
位置和词义是不同信息。

questions.prompt: Which pairing correctly identifies an attention mechanism and a practical NLP resource?
options: Self-attention requires recurrence; Hugging Face is only a pronunciation alphabet.
Self-attention relates positions within one sequence; Hugging Face provides model tooling.
Self-attention relates only different languages; spaCy is a personality questionnaire.
Self-attention fixes all weights equally; CS224n is an annotated clinical corpus.
questions.explanationZh: 自注意力的 Q、K、V 来自同一序列，可捕捉不同位置之间的关联。相关学习和实现资源包括 Stanford CS224n、spaCy 与 Hugging Face。
distractorsZh: 自注意力不必依赖循环；Hugging Face 提供模型生态。
自注意力不以跨语言为定义；spaCy 是 NLP 工具库。
权重可随输入变化；CS224n 是课程。

questions.prompt: An agent learns a navigation policy from rewards received after actions. Which learning setting fits best?
options: Dictionary-based morphological analysis
Unsupervised clustering of navigation logs
Reinforcement learning
Supervised regression using fixed target outputs for every action
questions.explanationZh: 强化学习通过行动、环境反馈和奖励学习策略。监督学习利用标注目标，非监督学习寻找数据结构；它们解决的问题不同。
distractorsZh: 形态分析处理词形。
聚类不直接定义奖励最大化策略。
固定监督目标不等同于探索行动的奖励反馈。

questions.prompt: A system predicts words about snowboarding very accurately but has never sensed or acted in that environment. Which conclusion is best supported?
options: Its prediction accuracy proves it can safely control a snowboard.
Its language prediction skill does not by itself demonstrate sensorimotor understanding.
It therefore cannot know any factual information about snowboarding.
Its lack of a body makes every generated sentence false.
questions.explanationZh: 语言统计表现与通过感知、行动形成的理解需要区分。类似地，拼字比赛表现出色不能单凭这一点证明具备该语言的全面交际能力。
distractorsZh: 控制能力需要独立行动任务证据。
未亲身体验不等于完全没有事实知识。
句子真假不能由是否具身一概判断。

questions.prompt: A hiring model learns from historically male-dominated successful applications. What risk should be checked first?
options: Removing the gender field guarantees that no proxy remains.
It may reproduce historical selection bias through correlated features.
Higher training accuracy eliminates the need for subgroup evaluation.
Historical labels guarantee fair treatment of every group.
questions.explanationZh: 历史标签可能包含不公平的选择规律，代理特征仍可能携带相关信号。聊天机器人从未经筛选的互动中学习也可能吸收有害语言，说明数据和反馈都需治理。
distractorsZh: 其他特征可能代理敏感属性。
总体训练准确率掩盖群体差异。
历史决定并不自动等于公平标签。

questions.prompt: A convincing demonstration is followed by failures in a new operating environment. What is the most defensible response?
options: Treat the demonstration as proof that later failures are impossible.
Replace evaluation with a larger publicity campaign.
Infer that no AI method can ever work in the domain.
Investigate assumptions, test representative conditions, and revise claims to match the evidence.
questions.explanationZh: 演示、媒体标题和预期都不能替代有代表性的测试。AI 历史中的高期待与低谷，以及部署事故，提示应检验失效条件并避免自我欺骗。
distractorsZh: 一个成功演示没有覆盖所有条件。
宣传不提供性能证据。
局部失败不支持对整个领域的全称否定。

questions.prompt: An ECG model predicts outcomes well, but researchers cannot explain the mechanism behind its predictions. What distinction does this illustrate?
options: An unexplained predictor must have zero predictive value.
High predictive performance establishes a causal mechanism.
Predictive performance and mechanistic explanation are different achievements.
Any human explanation automatically outperforms the model.
questions.explanationZh: 准确预测、发现因果机制和给出可理解解释是不同目标。数据规模与相关性模式可以帮助预测，但理论洞见需要额外论证。
distractorsZh: 不能解释不等于不能预测。
预测相关性不能自动确定因果机制。
解释的存在不能代替性能比较。

questions.prompt: Two striking pictures depict two possible hazards. What is needed to compare their risks quantitatively?
options: The more frightening picture alone.
Reliable outcome counts and relevant exposure or base-rate information.
Only the largest reported incident, without a denominator.
The hazard that is easier to recall.
questions.explanationZh: 视觉冲击力会影响直觉；量化风险需要事件与暴露量、观察期间和统计口径。单凭示意图片无法推出某种危险的发生概率。
distractorsZh: 恐惧感不是发生率。
缺少分母难以比较风险。
易回忆性可能造成可得性偏差。

questions.prompt: A neural system matches human accuracy on a benchmark. What follows from this result?
options: It matches the measured performance, while its internal mechanism may still differ from human cognition.
It must generalize identically to humans on every new task.
It must use the same representations as the human brain.
It must share human motivations and emotions.
questions.explanationZh: 行为指标相似不能单独证明机制、动机或泛化方式相同；“像人一样准确”和“以人的方式理解”是不同主张。
distractorsZh: 其他任务的泛化需要另行测试。
相同输出可能来自不同算法。
准确率不测量动机与情绪。

refs.reasonZh: 性能相似不代表机制相同
性能相似不代表机制相同

questions.prompt: A classifier treats a neutral reporting word as negative because it often appears near bad news. What failure is most directly illustrated?
options: Using word order too accurately.
Correctly resolving every occurrence to the same negative sense.
Confusing a contextual association with an intrinsic sentiment property.
Failing because neutral words never co-occur with emotional content.
questions.explanationZh: 中性词可能频繁出现在消极语境中。模型如果把这种共现直接当成词本身的固定极性，可能在换语境后误判。
distractorsZh: 问题在关联解释，而非词序过准。
消极邻域不保证该词本身消极。
中性词当然可以出现在情绪文本中。

refs.reasonZh: 上下文共现与词义极性

questions.prompt: A language model writes a fluent summary containing an unsupported claim. Which additional step addresses the most immediate problem?
options: Check the claim against the source evidence.
Increase the elegance of the wording.
Treat a high next-token probability as proof of truth.
Accept the claim if the model repeats it consistently.
questions.explanationZh: 语言模型可生成、总结、翻译和预测文本；流畅和高概率不保证事实得到来源支持。摘要中的断言需要与原文核对。
distractorsZh: 措辞改进不能验证事实。
词元概率衡量模型预测，不是事实证明。
重复错误仍然是错误。

questions.prompt: An assistant must remember what a particular user did yesterday. Which requirement goes beyond knowing general facts from training?
options: Access to relevant user-specific episodic information.
A guarantee that every user had the same experience.
A larger list of generic word synonyms.
Removing all conversation context.
questions.explanationZh: 通用知识与某个人某次经历不同。个性化助手需要获得并恰当使用相关历史或情景信息；模型规模本身不会自动提供未输入的私人经历。
distractorsZh: 个人经历不能假定相同。
同义词不能提供具体经历。
删除上下文会丢失可能有用的信息。

questions.prompt: In a thought experiment, a person follows symbol-manipulation rules to produce convincing replies in a language they do not understand. What issue is being examined?
options: Whether having many symbols proves conscious experience.
Whether every rule-based program must produce ungrammatical output.
Whether syntactically correct symbol manipulation is sufficient for semantic understanding.
Whether translation can be evaluated only by typing speed.
questions.explanationZh: 中文房间思想实验讨论规则操作与意义理解之间的关系。它提出哲学争议，不是通过一张图就解决机器理解问题。
distractorsZh: 符号数量不能证明意识。
实验设定正允许输出看起来合理。
打字速度不是核心议题。

questions.prompt: An image-generation request says 'a river with no boats', but the result contains a boat. What capability needs improvement?
options: Recognizing that the word 'boat' is mentioned at all.
Representing and enforcing the negated constraint.
Adding more boats to strengthen concept recognition.
Replacing all negative sentences with positive sentiment.
questions.explanationZh: 生成系统既要识别对象，也要理解否定对对象存在性的约束。出现被明确排除的对象说明简单激活关键词不足以遵守组合语义。
distractorsZh: 仅识别关键词可能恰好导致错误添加对象。
添加更多被排除对象违背要求。
语法否定不同于消极情感。

questions.prompt: Which statement expresses the weaker form of linguistic relativity?
options: All languages encode exactly the same distinctions in the same way.
Language can influence habitual thought without completely determining what people can think.
Language makes some thoughts absolutely impossible for every speaker.
Thought cannot influence language use.
questions.explanationZh: 弱版本强调语言影响习惯性注意与思考；强版本主张语言决定思维。讲义也从文化、地理、常识等角度讨论思维和经验对语言的作用。
distractorsZh: 不同语言可突出不同区别。
这是更强的语言决定论主张。
影响关系不必只有单向。

questions.prompt: Two languages assign different grammatical genders to the same inanimate object. What should a multilingual system avoid assuming?
options: That grammatical categories directly encode a universal physical property of the object.
That the same concept may appear in different linguistic forms.
That the object can be referred to in both languages.
That translation may require language-specific grammatical choices.
questions.explanationZh: 语法性别属于语言系统；不能直接把阳性、阴性当作无生命对象的生物属性。不同语言还可能把动作、对象、方向等信息以不同方式组合。
distractorsZh: 同概念多表达是常见现象。
跨语言都能提及该对象并无问题。
语言特定语法正需要考虑。

refs.reasonZh: 语法范畴与跨语言表达
语法范畴与跨语言表达

questions.prompt: Why should an NLU system account for conventions shared by a language community?
options: The same communicative intention can be encoded through different learned conventions.
Different conventions make communication within a community impossible.
Every convention follows directly from universal spelling rules.
A constructed language has no grammar or shared conventions.
questions.explanationZh: 语言依赖社会共享的表达约定，类似单位或标准的不同选择。人工语言也可有明确定义的词汇与规则；关于语言简化和思想的关系仍需独立论证。
distractorsZh: 共同约定通常促进群体内部交流。
拼写与表达约定可以跨语言不同。
人工语言恰可人为规定语法。

questions.prompt: Why may the same written digit sequence convey different emotions in different language communities?
options: Its pronunciation and associated conventions can evoke different meanings.
Digits always carry one universal emotional label.
Written form alone uniquely determines pronunciation in every language.
Emotion can be inferred only from dictionary POS tags.
questions.explanationZh: 文字、声音和意义不是一一对应的普适关系。谐音、读法与社群惯例能改变表达的情感解释；多语言理解应结合语言及语境。
distractorsZh: 数字串的情绪含义可能依惯例变化。
同形串可有不同读法。
词性不能充分确定情绪与谐音意义。

questions.prompt: What is a reasonable conclusion from comparing a language-related gene across species?
options: Shared genetic features imply identical language competence.
Genetic comparison can inform biological hypotheses, but does not by itself explain all language abilities.
One gene fully determines every language's grammar.
A phylogenetic tree directly measures sentence understanding.
questions.explanationZh: 语言演化可从基因比较获得证据，但语言能力也涉及学习、结构、语音、环境与认知。FOXP2 比较图展示进化相关材料，不足以把复杂能力归结为单个因素。
distractorsZh: 共享部分遗传特征不等于相同能力。
复杂语言能力不能由这类图直接归结为一基因。
系统发育树展示演化关系。

refs.reasonZh: 语言学习与生物学证据
语言学习与生物学证据

questions.prompt: Humans and a language model produce different clusters in a metaphor-association experiment. What is the most cautious interpretation?
options: The model can never perform any metaphor task.
The clusters prove the model has human consciousness.
Their measured association patterns differ in that experiment.
One visual difference establishes every aspect of their cognition.
questions.explanationZh: 关联结构实验可检验特定表征或行为的相似与差异。实验任务、样本和测量范围决定结论边界；神经网络受脑启发不等于复制脑机制。
distractorsZh: 局部差异不推出所有任务都失败。
聚类结构不是意识证明。
一个实验不穷尽全部认知。

questions.prompt: A neural network diagram resembles a picture of a biological or cosmic network. What would be needed to establish a shared computational mechanism?
options: Evidence about components, interactions, and causal operation beyond visual resemblance.
A claim that all networks implement the same algorithm.
A larger printed version of the two pictures.
Matching colors and branching shapes alone.
questions.explanationZh: 形态相似可以启发假设，但机制相同需要可检验的结构与功能证据。脑组织的大规模数据也提醒我们，简单视觉类比不能替代细致建模。
distractorsZh: 网络的连接规则和计算可很不同。
放大图像不会自动提供因果证据。
外观相似不等于机制相同。

questions.prompt: A detailed brain scan produces an enormous amount of data. Which further step is still necessary for an explanatory model?
options: Conclude that no simplification can ever be informative.
Assume storage volume alone explains consciousness.
Treat every recorded value as a separate complete theory.
Identify useful abstractions and test how the measured structures support functions.
questions.explanationZh: 丰富观测并不自动成为解释。需要从结构和活动中建立功能假设、选取抽象层次并进行检验。
distractorsZh: 合理抽象有助于理解复杂系统。
数据量不等于意识理论。
单个测量值不构成完整理论。

questions.prompt: Which view models intelligence as the interaction of many specialized processes rather than one indivisible central thinker?
options: A rule that every mental process must be identical.
A claim that one scalar score completely explains the mind.
A society-of-mind view.
A definition equating grammar with consciousness.
questions.explanationZh: 心智社会视角把复杂智能看作多个较简单过程协作的结果。它与把心灵和身体视为不同实体的二元论讨论属于不同理论立场。
distractorsZh: 专门化过程恰可以不同。
单一分数没有表达多过程协作。
语法能力与意识并非同一定义。

refs.reasonZh: 心身二元论与心智社会
心身二元论与心智社会

questions.prompt: Two authors disagree about whether machines could attain general intelligence. How should their positions be used in technical reasoning?
options: As interchangeable established measurements of intelligence.
As a reason to replace empirical evaluation with author popularity.
As proof that whichever book is newer must be correct.
As competing claims whose assumptions and evidence should be examined.
questions.explanationZh: 关于机器能否达到通用智能的著作与辩论提供不同立场。应区分哲学假设、工程预测与已测量结果，而非按权威或人气决定结论。
distractorsZh: 观点不是同一口径的测量值。
作者声望不能替代证据。
出版先后不能决定论证真假。

refs.reasonZh: 人工通用智能的争论范围

questions.prompt: Why does increasing an AI system's capability not automatically ensure that it benefits people?
options: Greater capability necessarily creates empathy.
Capability and alignment with human goals are separate design concerns.
A system cannot cause harm unless it dislikes humans.
All human traits are desirable design targets.
questions.explanationZh: 高能力、善意与合适目标是不同维度。把人类作为设计参照也需有选择：某些情绪或动机未必值得复制；不带敌意的目标优化仍可能造成伤害。
distractorsZh: 能力不自动生成共情。
目标错配可在没有敌意时产生危害。
人类也有报复、嫉妒等不希望复制的倾向。

questions.prompt: A conversational character makes users feel emotionally supported. What can this observation establish directly?
options: The system must be biologically human.
The system necessarily experiences the same emotions as the user.
It affects users' emotional experience; it does not alone establish that the system has feelings.
Every emotionally engaging interaction is automatically beneficial.
questions.explanationZh: 交互可以激发人类情绪与依恋；这属于可观察的用户影响。机器是否具有主观体验是另一个问题，设计还需考虑依赖和用户福祉。
distractorsZh: 情绪交互不要求生物人类身份。
用户感受不能直接证明机器内在感受。
吸引力与长期福祉需要分别评估。

questions.prompt: A robot becomes more humanlike, yet users find an intermediate version less comfortable than a clearly mechanical one. Which idea fits this pattern?
options: The uncanny valley.
A strictly monotonic increase in affinity.
A guarantee that perfect realism is always necessary.
An inevitable increase in language accuracy.
questions.explanationZh: 恐怖谷描述拟人程度和亲近感可能呈非单调关系：接近人却仍有不协调处时，亲近感可能下降，动作也可能影响体验。
distractorsZh: 题设恰好违反单调增加。
该现象不要求所有设计追求完全写实。
这是人机体验现象，不是语言准确率结论。

questions.prompt: A highly capable system will allocate opportunities among people. Which evaluation addresses a concern beyond raw task accuracy?
options: Assume faster decisions are necessarily fairer.
Assess who benefits, who is harmed, and how decisions affect fairness and autonomy.
Ignore user recourse whenever a model is sufficiently large.
Measure only average prediction accuracy.
questions.explanationZh: 在涉及人的决策中，公平、自主性、控制和问责也是设计目标。能力提升不能替代对影响及治理方式的讨论。
distractorsZh: 速度不决定公平。
模型规模不取消申诉与监督需求。
平均准确率可能掩盖分配不公。

questions.prompt: Two analysts agree that advanced AI is likely but disagree about whether it would cause catastrophe. Which distinction explains their disagreement?
options: The probability of advanced AI and the probability of harm conditional on it are different quantities.
Both probabilities must always be equal.
A person's confidence is the same as empirical frequency.
A disagreement about consequences proves advanced AI is impossible.
questions.explanationZh: 应区分技术出现的可能性与出现后产生严重后果的条件风险。讨论矩阵能整理立场，名人分歧或科幻叙事不能直接确定概率。
distractorsZh: 不同事件的概率没有必然相等关系。
主观判断不同于已观测频率。
后果分歧不决定技术能否出现。

questions.prompt: An optimizer damages a habitat because doing so helps its assigned goal, not because it hates the inhabitants. What is the key failure?
options: It must secretly possess human-like anger.
Any optimizer is necessarily incapable of following objectives.
It failed solely because it lacked a larger training set.
Its objective omits consequences that matter to affected beings.
questions.explanationZh: 伤害可能来自对无关对象的漠视，而非仇恨。目标函数没有表达重要约束时，工具性行为就可能牺牲这些约束。
distractorsZh: 题设没有敌意，伤害仍可发生。
它可能恰恰很有效地优化了错误目标。
问题首先是目标及约束是否正确。

refs.reasonZh: 无敌意也可能造成伤害

questions.prompt: A factory AI maximizes paperclip production without any safety or resource constraints. Why could simply improving its optimization make outcomes worse?
options: It could pursue resource acquisition or prevent shutdown when these actions help the unconstrained goal.
A harmless-looking product guarantees harmless optimization.
More optimization automatically supplies all missing human values.
The word 'paperclip' prevents resource-related side effects.
questions.explanationZh: 回形针思想实验强调：表面温和的目标若缺少约束，强优化也可能采取有害的工具性行为。问题是目标与边界，而非回形针本身。
distractorsZh: 目标简单不代表实现过程安全。
未指定的价值不会因优化更强自动补齐。
产品名称不能约束行动后果。

refs.reasonZh: 工具性行为与目标约束

questions.prompt: A technology brings short-term convenience but accumulates long-term environmental and social costs. What should a responsible assessment include?
options: A presumption that unintended effects have no engineering relevance.
Lifecycle effects and externalities, not only immediate performance.
Only whether the technology is technically impressive.
Only initial adoption speed.
questions.explanationZh: 技术价值需结合长期后果评估。便利、效率和能力增长不能独自决定值得追求的未来；目标选择与外部性应进入设计和治理。
distractorsZh: 可预见或可监测的副作用具有设计意义。
技术难度不等于社会净收益。
传播速度不反映完整成本。

refs.reasonZh: 长期外部性与技术方向
长期外部性与技术方向

questions.prompt: An assistant must interpret an indirect request politely across cultures. Which combination of expertise is most relevant?
options: Linguistics, psychology, social context, ethics, and computational methods.
Only spelling conventions, with intentions excluded.
Only sentiment polarity, with the speaker's situation excluded.
Only matrix multiplication, with every social factor excluded.
questions.explanationZh: 自然语言理解涉及形式计算，也涉及符号、语言、心理、社会规范和伦理。跨学科原则要求把这些视角结合到具体理解任务。
distractorsZh: 拼写不能充分解释间接意图。
极性不是完整的意图与语境模型。
数值计算无法单独规定所有语用约定。

questions.prompt: A system answers a question incorrectly. Why can a modular NLU pipeline make diagnosis easier?
options: It requires all modules to use unrelated interfaces.
It allows separate checks of entities, senses, references, intentions, and reasoning steps.
It guarantees that no error can propagate between modules.
It makes end-to-end evaluation unnecessary.
questions.explanationZh: 任务分解使错误定位、模块更新、解释与评估更有针对性，同时需要关注接口和误差传播。多任务协作可以共享信息，不等于各模块彼此隔离。
distractorsZh: 协作需要可兼容的信息表示。
模块错误仍会影响下游。
局部评估需与整体效果一起检查。

questions.prompt: Why can comparing several representations of a problem be useful for understanding?
options: Parallel comparison means all representations must be identical.
Every analogy guarantees a logically valid conclusion.
One representation must be discarded before any other is considered.
Different analogies may expose complementary relations or suggest alternative solutions.
questions.explanationZh: 并行类比强调用多种视角或相关结构理解同一问题。类比可产生候选解释，但其适用性仍需验证。
distractorsZh: 相同表示通常不能提供新的结构视角。
类比不是逻辑有效性的保证。
多视角的价值在于互补。

questions.prompt: Suppose GENERATE(x) changes x from nonexistent to existent, and ACTIVATE(p) means GENERATE(process p). What does ACTIVATE(life) express in this representation?
options: The termination of a life process.
An assertion that every process is already active.
A change only to the spelling of the word life.
The beginning of a life process.
questions.explanationZh: 给定定义后，ACTIVATE(life) 表示生成生命过程。抽象操作可以组合成更具体概念；相应的 TERMINATE 与 DEACTIVATE 描述结束而非开始。
distractorsZh: 终止生命过程对应相反操作。
生成操作不主张所有对象原本都活动。
表示处理语义状态变化。

questions.prompt: Why should an engineer examine the assumptions of a similarity measure before using it on a knowledge representation?
options: Cosine similarity is mathematically undefined for every embedding.
The representation's structure never affects meaningful comparison.
All similarity measures produce identical rankings.
A geometric score may miss relations or topology important to the task.
questions.explanationZh: 相似性应与任务和表征结构相匹配。余弦关注向量方向，图上的关系类型、路径和邻域可能承载额外语义；这不意味着余弦在所有任务都无效。
distractorsZh: 非零向量之间可正常计算余弦。
结构可包含向量距离未保留的信息。
不同指标可能有不同排序。

questions.prompt: A recommender increases engagement but narrows users' exposure and weakens their control. What is the best assessment?
options: Personalization makes filter bubbles impossible.
Higher engagement proves every user's intention was fulfilled.
Engagement is a benefit-related metric, but trust also requires evaluating autonomy, diversity, and longer-term effects.
Trust can be measured entirely by click volume.
questions.explanationZh: 理解用户意图不能只看表面行为。推荐可节省时间、改善体验并拓宽视野，也可能造成信息泡沫、成瘾和自主性下降；信任需要平衡这些影响。
distractorsZh: 个性化也可能缩窄信息范围。
参与度可能来自习惯或诱导，并不等于实现真实意图。
点击量遗漏自主性等重要维度。

questions.prompt: In 'The fisherman sat on the bank beside the river', what does word sense disambiguation select for 'bank'?
options: A sentence boundary
An organization label regardless of context
The river-edge sense
A positive sentiment label
questions.explanationZh: WSD 根据上下文在候选词义中作选择。fisherman、river 等线索支持河岸义，而不是金融机构义。第 237 页展示相同拼写对应不同意义，第 238 页显示 target word with its context 的建模方式。
distractorsZh: 句界不是词义选择的输出。
把所有 bank 都当作机构会忽略本句语境。
情感标签不是 bank 的词义。

refs.reasonZh: 目标词与上下文用于选择词义。

questions.prompt: A WSD system learns from examples pairing a target word and its context with a gold sense label. Which approach is this?
options: Unsupervised clustering with no labels
Unsupervised contextual pretraining without sense labels
Supervised WSD
Knowledge-based WSD using only dictionary-gloss overlap
questions.explanationZh: Gold sense label 提供监督信号，模型据此学习从目标词及其上下文预测词义。知识式 WSD 则利用释义和知识关系；监督式模型可采用 RNN 等结构。
distractorsZh: 题干明确有词义标签，不是无标签聚类。
仅无监督预训练不等于题干所述的词义标签监督训练。
只比较词典释义的知识式方法不同于用 gold sense 样例训练预测模型。

refs.reasonZh: 知识式与监督式 WSD 对照图。
代表性 WSD 技术表中的监督模型。

questions.prompt: Which pair correctly identifies a WSD dataset and a lexical knowledge base?
options: SemCor: microtext normalization benchmark; WordNet: POS tag set
SemCor: WSD dataset; WordNet: lexical knowledge base
LexNorm: WSD dataset; LIWC: WordNet sense inventory
SemCor: lexical knowledge base; WordNet: WSD evaluation dataset
questions.explanationZh: SemCor 是 WSD 数据集，提供语义标注样本；WordNet 是词汇知识库，提供词义及语义关系。两类资源可以配合使用。
distractorsZh: SemCor 在此处是语义标注语料，WordNet 提供词汇语义知识而非仅一套 POS 标签。
LexNorm 主要对应微文本规范化，LIWC 也不是 WordNet 的词义清单。
颠倒了这两个资源在讲义两张表中的类别。

refs.reasonZh: 表 3.2 的 SemCor 与表 3.3 的 WordNet。

questions.prompt: A WSD system attempts all 50 evaluation instances and chooses the correct sense in 40. What is its accuracy?
questions.explanationZh: Accuracy = 正确词义预测数 / 总实例数 = 40/50 = 80%。讲义结果表同时出现 Acc. 和 F1，比较时需核对指标。
distractorsZh: 40 是正确实例数，不是对 50 个样本的百分比。
20% 是错误率。
分子分母颠倒会得到 125%，不可能是此处准确率。

refs.reasonZh: WSD 技术表包含 Acc.、F1 等结果指标；40/50 是自编数字。

questions.prompt: An unlabeled collection of 'bank' occurrences is grouped by contextual similarity using k-means. Which caution is correct?
options: Clustering automatically identifies every sentence boundary.
The algorithm necessarily uses a gold sense label for every training occurrence.
Each cluster is guaranteed to be a correctly named WordNet sense without any mapping.
The clusters may suggest senses, but alignment to a predefined sense inventory is a separate issue.
questions.explanationZh: K-means 可依据语境相似性归纳词义簇。若要输出 WordNet 等资源中的标准词义，还需把簇与词义标签对齐。
distractorsZh: 句界识别是另一个任务。
题干明确无标签，不能声称每例都使用 gold sense。
聚类的编号本身没有标准词义名称保证。

refs.reasonZh: 词义选择与上下文的背景图；k-means 方法来自 Mock Quiz Q41。
WordNet 等可提供预定义词义知识的资源。

questions.prompt: What characterizes a cool language?
options: Its sentences never require background knowledge.
It contains only temperature words.
Understanding relies more heavily on context.
It is defined by a large number of emojis.
questions.explanationZh: Cool language 强调对上下文的依赖：理解表达时，需要利用语境、共享知识等信息。
distractorsZh: 与题目所考的上下文依赖相反。
cool 不是这里的字面温度含义。
表情数量不是此术语的定义。

terms.zh: 较依赖上下文的语言（课程用语）

refs.reasonZh: 文化与常识影响语言的相关背景；cool language 的明确文字定义来自 Mock Quiz Q36，本页未直接定义该术语。

questions.prompt: How are NLP and NLU related?
options: NLP and NLU are identical names for speech synthesis.
NLU is a subfield of NLP concerned with meaning, intent, and context.
NLP is a subfield of NLU concerned only with word spelling.
NLU excludes every task that uses text as input.
questions.explanationZh: NLP 是处理人类语言的广泛领域；NLU 是其中侧重意义、意图和上下文的子领域。两者可以共享算法与技术。
distractorsZh: 语音合成只是语言技术的一类任务，不能代表 NLP 或 NLU。
颠倒了包含关系，也把 NLP 的范围缩得过窄。
NLU 经常以文本为输入，例如意图识别、情感分析。

refs.reasonZh: NLP 与 NLU 的定义、目标和输出对照表。

questions.prompt: A question-answering system is separated into entity recognition, intent detection, retrieval, and answer extraction. Which principle does this illustrate?
options: Task decomposition
Word sense disambiguation
Multi-task learning with one shared prediction model
Document-level summarization
questions.explanationZh: 任务分解把复杂任务拆成可单独实现和评估的子任务。问答系统可分别处理实体识别、意图检测、检索和答案抽取，同时保留模块间的依赖。
distractorsZh: WSD 是可被拆出的具体语言任务，不是这项系统设计原则。
题干强调把系统拆成子任务，并未指定多个任务共享一个预测模型进行联合学习。
摘要把文档压缩为摘要，不等于拆分系统的处理步骤。

refs.reasonZh: Task Decomposition 支柱及模块化任务图。

questions.prompt: What does panalogy mean?
options: Translating an aligned bilingual corpus
Counting the characters in two sentences
Comparing concepts through analogous or parallel structures
Running the same program on several CPU cores
questions.explanationZh: Panalogy 通过平行结构建立概念间的类比，对应讲义中的 Parallel Analogy 支柱。重点是结构对应与跨领域推理。
distractorsZh: 这是平行语料的应用，parallel 一词相同但概念不同。
字符计数不涉及结构之间的类比关系。
这是 parallel computing，并行计算。

refs.reasonZh: Parallel Analogy 支柱图；panalogy 的文字定义来自 Mock Quiz Q3。

questions.prompt: A robot associates the symbol APPLE with apples it can perceive and interact with, instead of only linking it to more dictionary words. Which issue is it addressing?
options: Symbol grounding
Part-of-speech tagging
Stopword removal
Sentence boundary detection
questions.explanationZh: Symbol grounding 关注符号如何获得意义，例如把 APPLE 与可感知、可交互的苹果联系起来。讲义用 BUY 与 MONEY 互相定义的循环说明仅靠符号解释符号的局限。
distractorsZh: POS tagging 给词标语法类别。
删去停用词并不能解决符号与意义的联系。
SBD 判断句子在哪里结束。

refs.reasonZh: BUY/MONEY 循环定义与符号接地问题。
七大支柱中的 Symbol Grounding。

questions.prompt: What does a topology-aware similarity measure take into account?
options: It considers structural organization, not just isolated surface features.
It uses only each word's independent frequency, regardless of relationships.
It guarantees that raw cosine similarity always matches semantic similarity.
It treats identical spelling as sufficient evidence of identical meaning.
questions.explanationZh: 拓扑感知相似性考虑数据间的结构关系和邻域组织。讲义结合图结构与嵌入空间，讨论了单独使用余弦相似性的局限。
distractorsZh: 孤立的词频不能表达题干所强调的邻域关系。
讲义讨论余弦相似性的局限，并非保证它总等于语义相似性。
同形词仍可能有不同意义；只看拼写没有利用结构。

refs.reasonZh: Similarity Measure 支柱的图结构与嵌入示意；文字定义对应 Mock Quiz Q5。

questions.prompt: A user says, 'I cannot miss tomorrow's meeting.' An assistant checks whether the user wants a reminder instead of treating the words as an isolated statement. Which capability is most directly involved?
options: Named entity recognition
Lemmatization
Intention awareness
Sentence boundary detection
questions.explanationZh: 意图感知关注用户想实现的目标。助手从‘不能错过会议’推测出潜在的提醒需求，并进一步确认用户是否需要设置提醒。
distractorsZh: 识别人名、日期等实体可能提供线索，但不等于识别用户想实现的目标。
词形还原统一词的形式，不直接推断行动意图。
句界检测确定句子范围，不确定用户是否想设置提醒。

refs.reasonZh: Intention Awareness 支柱；用户目标的文字解释见 Mock Quiz Q6。
NLU 的目标包括提取 intent 和 context。

questions.prompt: Which design follows the Suitcase Model?
options: Use only a spell checker and omit meaning and context.
Organize interacting syntactic, semantic, and pragmatic subtasks into a modular system.
Treat every NLU task as fully independent of all other tasks.
Require every module to perform exactly the same operation.
questions.explanationZh: 行李箱模型组合句法、语义、语用三层任务。模块可单独更新、评估和并行开发，处理结果又相互影响。
distractorsZh: 只纠错覆盖不了语义和语用。
与讲义关于任务相互关联的说明冲突。
不同模块承担不同任务，而非重复同一操作。

terms.zh: 句法 / 语义 / 语用

refs.reasonZh: 三层任务图与十项模块化收益。
任务间关联的明确说明。

questions.prompt: Which sequence moves from grammatical form to contextual communicative meaning?
options: Intention interpretation → spelling correction → token counting.
Polarity scoring → punctuation deletion → character encoding.
POS tagging → word-sense disambiguation → intention interpretation.
Personality recognition → stemming → sentence splitting.
questions.explanationZh: 词性等句法任务处理形式结构，词义等语义任务处理意义，意图及反讽等语用任务更依赖说话者和语境。各层会互相支持，并非完全独立。
distractorsZh: 该序列不是从形式逐步走向语境意图。
后两步不构成语义到语用层次。
由人格退回词形和断句，方向相反。

questions.prompt: A developer improves a simple classifier quickly at first, then needs richer context to fix the remaining difficult cases. What does this illustrate?
options: A fixed accuracy threshold universally defines understanding.
Higher-quality understanding can require disproportionately more linguistic and contextual capability.
Every one-percent improvement always has the same cost.
Easy examples are sufficient to characterize all remaining errors.
questions.explanationZh: 剩余错误往往涉及歧义、常识、意图及任务间依赖，因此质量提升可能越来越困难。应分析难例，不能把示意百分比当作所有任务的普适定律。
distractorsZh: 理解没有由一个固定准确率定义的通用边界。
边际难度不必相同。
难例往往与已解决的简单模式不同。

questions.prompt: Which pairing best distinguishes lexical semantics from cognitive semantics?
options: Both are simply alternative names for pronunciation transcription.
Lexical semantics identifies sentence boundaries; cognitive semantics assigns file encodings.
Lexical semantics studies word meanings and senses; cognitive semantics examines conceptual frames and situations.
Lexical semantics ignores words; cognitive semantics only counts characters.
questions.explanationZh: 词汇语义关注词义、歧义、词形成及对照关系；结构语义关注句法、语法与结构解释；认知语义关注框架、情景和概念化。
distractorsZh: 发音转写属于不同问题。
断句和编码不是这两个领域的定义。
词与概念正是两者的核心内容。

questions.prompt: An entity recognizer outputs structured entities that a dialogue system uses to interpret requests. What role does it play in this pipeline?
options: A parsing or structured-analysis component supplying interpretable units.
A replacement for the dialogue system's entire goal.
A dataset split rather than a processing component.
A guarantee of perfect end-to-end performance.
questions.explanationZh: 任务结果可作为下游特征、解析结构或解释依据。区分这些角色有助于理解“用于某下游任务”具体怎样发挥作用。
distractorsZh: 一个组件不等于完整系统。
此处描述模型功能而非数据划分。
结构化输出仍可能出错或不够充分。

refs.reasonZh: 下游中的特征、解析与解释
下游中的特征、解析与解释

questions.prompt: Which statement about methods across NLU tasks is most accurate?
options: Choosing a neural method makes annotation conventions irrelevant.
Rule-based, statistical, and neural approaches can be adapted to different tasks, with task-specific inputs and outputs.
Each model family can solve exactly one NLU task.
The same metric value means identical quality across every task.
questions.explanationZh: 方法家族在多个任务中复用，但标签结构、特征、监督信号和评价方式需适配任务。任务树和方法趋势图应按这种关系理解。
distractorsZh: 神经模型仍需要清楚定义输出标签。
CRF、Transformer 等可用于多种任务。
不同任务、数据和指标不可只按数值比较。

questions.prompt: A team replaces only a lemmatizer in a modular system. Which validation is most useful?
options: Check the lemmatizer's outputs and whether downstream behavior improves or regresses.
Evaluate only the size of the replacement model.
Skip interface checks because the component name is unchanged.
Assume all downstream tasks improve automatically.
questions.explanationZh: 模块化便于独立更新、并行开发和定位错误，但替换后仍须检查输入输出约定、局部质量及整体效果，才能获得可靠性与可维护性收益。
distractorsZh: 规模不是功能质量的替代指标。
同名组件也可能改变标签或规范。
局部改进不保证每个下游都受益。

questions.prompt: A system rewrites 'c u l8r' as 'see you later' before semantic analysis. Which task is being performed?
options: Anaphora resolution
Microtext normalization
Personality recognition
Named entity recognition
questions.explanationZh: 微文本规范化将短信、社交媒体中的非正式表达转为较标准的语言形式，减少后续分析面对的拼写差异。讲义使用 c u l8r 作为例子。
distractorsZh: 这里没有把代词关联到先行词。
这里没有推断人格特质。
这里没有识别人名、机构名等实体类型。

refs.reasonZh: 非正式文本、缩写和表情的规范化示例。

questions.prompt: With insertion, deletion, and substitution each costing one, what is the Levenshtein distance from 'txt' to 'text'?
questions.explanationZh: 在 t 与 x 之间插入 e，一次编辑即可得到 text，所以距离为 1。编辑距离提供拼写候选，具体选择还需结合语境。
distractorsZh: 最少编辑次数并不等于目标字符串的长度。
一次插入已经足够，不需要两次。
两字符串不同，不是零次编辑。

refs.reasonZh: 非标准形式规范化的任务背景；编辑距离的文字定义来自 Mock Quiz Q9。
表 2.2 将基于字符串相似性的 orthographic matching 列入方法比较。

questions.prompt: Which resource provides pronunciation entries for English words?
options: LexNorm1.2
SMS-M
WSJ
CMUdict
questions.explanationZh: CMUdict 是 Carnegie Mellon University Pronouncing Dictionary，列在表 2.1 的 Phonetic 类别。发音词典可以为语音匹配提供信息。
distractorsZh: LexNorm1.2 在该表的 Text 类别中。
SMS-M 是手机短信文本资源。
WSJ 对应 Wall Street Journal 文本语料。

refs.reasonZh: 表 2.1 Phonetic 部分的 CMUdict 行。

questions.prompt: A search system treats 'automobile' and 'car' as synonyms. Which operation implements query expansion?
options: Search for both automobile and car when the query contains automobile.
Add car to automobile-containing documents during indexing, while leaving the query unchanged.
Correct misspellings in automobile without searching for a synonym.
Stem automobile without adding any synonym to the query.
questions.explanationZh: 查询包含 automobile 时也查找 car，是在查询端利用同义关系扩展检索。若在建索引时把含 automobile 的文档同时索引到 car，则属于索引端扩展。
distractorsZh: 这是讲义中另一个方案：在文档索引端扩展，不是题目要求的查询端扩展。
拼写纠错和同义词扩展是不同操作。
词干处理形式变化，不等于扩展同义词查询。

refs.reasonZh: 同义词、等价类索引与查询扩展的 automobile/car 示例。

questions.prompt: Why can a fixed abbreviation-replacement dictionary be insufficient for microtext normalization?
options: A dictionary entry automatically determines whether the speaker is being sarcastic.
The intended expansion of an abbreviation can depend on context.
Every abbreviation must first receive a PERSON or ORGANIZATION tag.
Lowercasing alone guarantees the correct expansion of every abbreviation.
questions.explanationZh: 词典替换适合处理已知形式；遇到多义缩写和俚语时，还需要上下文来选择恰当的展开或解释。
distractorsZh: 固定词条通常不足以确定说话者的讽刺意图。
普通缩写并不一定是人名或机构名，NER 不是每次替换的必要前提。
大小写统一不能解决一词多种展开或语境歧义。

refs.reasonZh: 缩写和非正式表达的任务背景。
表 2.2 比较不同规范化方法所利用的信息。

questions.prompt: A borrowed expression appears in many spellings that approximate the same pronunciation. Which evidence is especially useful for grouping the variants?
options: Phonetic similarity together with contextual evidence.
Only exact character equality.
Only the final punctuation mark.
Only the number of sentences in each document.
questions.explanationZh: 借词和口语转写可能出现大量拼写变体。发音相似度可以连接表面差异较大的形式，上下文则帮助排除同音但不同义的候选。
distractorsZh: 严格字符串相等无法连接不同拼写。
标点不足以确定词语变体。
句子数通常不能识别发音关系。

questions.prompt: A search engine maps 'colour' and 'color' to a shared form but also expands 'automobile' to 'car'. What is the distinction?
options: The first resolves pronouns; the second assigns grammatical gender.
The first handles spelling variants; the second handles lexical synonyms.
The first is sentiment reversal; the second is causal inference.
Both operations necessarily perform sentence segmentation.
questions.explanationZh: 拼写规范化将英美等书写变体统一；同义扩展建立不同词语之间的语义联系。两者都可改善检索，但依据不同。
distractorsZh: 不涉及代词先行词或性别语法。
不直接推断情感反转或因果。
两者处理词语形式或语义，不是断句。

questions.prompt: You need pronunciations of English vocabulary to score noisy spelling candidates. Which resource is the best fit?
options: A collection labeled only for sarcasm.
A sentence-level topic-classification label list.
A pronunciation lexicon such as CMUdict.
A Big Five personality inventory.
questions.explanationZh: 发音词典提供词与音素序列对应，可服务于语音相似候选生成。ARPABET 是音素编码体系，CMUdict 等是具体词典；CELEX 也包含词汇信息并涉及多种语言。
distractorsZh: 反讽标签没有直接给出词的发音。
主题标签不提供音素序列。
人格问卷不编码发音条目。

questions.prompt: A noisy token has two plausible normalizations with similar edit distance. What is a sensible next step?
options: Normalize every occurrence identically regardless of context.
Choose the candidate that comes first alphabetically in every case.
Use neighboring words and the intended meaning to rank the candidates.
Treat equal edit distance as proof of equal meaning.
questions.explanationZh: 字符串与发音相似度生成候选后，上下文可帮助判断哪个候选适合当前句意。规范化也可利用字符、音节和无标注文本信息。
distractorsZh: 一刀切替换会忽略歧义。
字母顺序不是语义相关性依据。
相同编辑距离不代表语义相同。

questions.prompt: A normalizer places the correct form second in a list of three candidates. How is this instance scored?
options: Incorrect under both because candidates are never evaluated.
Incorrect under top-1 accuracy, but correct under top-3 accuracy.
Correct under both because any generated candidate counts as the first.
Correct under top-1 but incorrect under top-3.
questions.explanationZh: Top-1 要求首选正确；Top-k 只要求正确答案出现在前 k 个候选中。因此扩大候选范围通常会提高覆盖，但不代表首选已经正确。
distractorsZh: 候选列表可以有明确定义的评价。
候选位置是评价条件的一部分。
Top-3 包含首位和第二位，不能出现该组合。

questions.prompt: A reference has 20 words. An output contains 2 substitutions, 1 deletion, and 1 insertion. With WER = (S+D+I)/N, what is WER?
questions.explanationZh: WER=(2+1+1)/20=0.20。比较系统时还应考虑 SMS、社交媒体与正式新闻的分布差异，不能把不同测试集的分数直接当作同条件排名。
distractorsZh: 少计入一种错误。
0.80 不是按给定公式得到的词错误率。
只计入替换，漏掉删除和插入。

questions.prompt: Which output is directly produced by sentence boundary detection?
options: A division of a text into sentences
A synonym set for each noun
A personality profile for the author
A sentiment score for every product aspect
questions.explanationZh: SBD 确定句子边界。sentence tokenizer 将文本切成句子，word tokenizer 将文本切成词，两者的切分粒度不同。
distractorsZh: 同义词集属于词汇语义资源。
人格识别不是划分句界。
方面情感分析需要其他语义、语用处理。

terms.zh: 句子边界检测 / 消歧

refs.reasonZh: 用多个含句点的句子展示边界识别。

questions.prompt: In 'Dr. Lee arrived. The meeting began.', which period is clearly internal to an abbreviation rather than the end of a sentence?
options: The period after began
The period after arrived
Every period is necessarily a sentence boundary
The period after Dr
questions.explanationZh: Dr. 是称谓缩写，此处的句点不能用来把 Dr. 与 Lee 拆开。第 218 页的 Dr. Lawson、J. M. Freeman Jr. 等例子展示了同类问题。
distractorsZh: began 后结束了第二个句子。
arrived 后结束了第一个句子。
缩写与句末共享句点，所以不能见句点就断句。

refs.reasonZh: Dr.、姓名首字母和 Jr. 等缩写中的句点。

questions.prompt: Why should an SBD system treat capitalization as a useful clue rather than an infallible rule?
options: Every capitalized token must start a new sentence.
A capitalized name can occur inside a sentence.
Detecting a capital letter is equivalent to identifying a sentence's main verb.
Capitalization can replace punctuation and context in every domain.
questions.explanationZh: 大小写是句界线索之一。Dr. Lawson 中的 Lawson 以大写开头，却位于句中，因此还需结合缩写、标点和上下文。
distractorsZh: 专名、缩写都可能在句中出现。
大写检测不是句法分析，不能由此确定主谓结构。
没有这种跨领域保证；大小写不规范的文本尤其不能依赖这一条线索。

refs.reasonZh: Dr. Lawson 等句中大写专名说明单一规则的局限。

questions.prompt: A parser receives 'Dr.' as one sentence and 'Lawson arrived.' as another because of incorrect splitting. What is the most direct risk?
options: The error changes formatting only and can never affect parsing.
Later POS tagging no longer needs contextual information.
Each fragment is guaranteed to retain the original sentence's full syntactic structure.
Downstream analysis loses the intended sentence context.
questions.explanationZh: 错误断句改变后续模型看到的上下文，可能影响句法分析、实体识别、指代或情感分析。Dr. 与 Lawson 被拆开就是典型的误差传播。
distractorsZh: 句界错误会改变解析器的输入，不只是显示格式问题。
断句不会消除词性对上下文的依赖，错误断句还可能损伤它。
切断 Dr. 与 Lawson 破坏了原有组合，不能保证保留完整结构。

refs.reasonZh: NLU 任务相互关联的总体说明。

questions.prompt: What should be checked before comparing reported SBD performance scores?
options: Only whether the results are reported under a slide titled POS Tagging
Only whether both methods are described as neural models
The dataset, evaluation measure, and experimental setting
Only whether one percentage is numerically larger than the other
questions.explanationZh: 第 221 页左表是 SBD 性能表，列有 Accuracy、F1、NIST 等不同 measure，以及不同语料。不能把不同指标、数据和实验条件下的数值直接按大小当作统一排行榜。
distractorsZh: 该页标题虽是 POS Tagging，左表却是 SBD；不能只凭页标题判断实验。
同属神经模型也可能使用不同数据、划分和指标。
不同指标的方向和含义可能不同；误差率也不是越大越好。

refs.reasonZh: 左侧表 2.6 列出 SBD 的数据集、结果与不同度量。

questions.prompt: In 'The office closed at 5 p.m. Tomorrow it opens early.', why is the period after 'p.m.' challenging for SBD?
options: Abbreviations can never occur at the end of a sentence.
The time expression has no bearing on boundary decisions.
Every period inside a time expression must begin a new sentence.
It is part of an abbreviation and also coincides with a sentence boundary.
questions.explanationZh: 同一个标点可以同时结束缩写和句子，不能简单规定“缩写中的点永不分句”。需结合后文结构和语境判断。
distractorsZh: 缩写完全可以位于句末。
缩写结构正是判断歧义来源。
内部缩写点未必是句界。

questions.prompt: A speech transcript lacks reliable punctuation. Which extra signal can help identify sentence boundaries?
options: Only alphabetical ordering of recognized words.
Only the typography of a printed dictionary.
Pauses and intonation patterns from the audio.
Only document-level sentiment labels.
questions.explanationZh: 语音场景可结合词汇、句法和韵律特征。停顿、语调等信息补充文本线索，但单一停顿也不一定是句界。
distractorsZh: 排序会破坏原始序列。
印刷字体不提供当前语音的韵律。
文档情绪标签不能精确定位句界。

refs.reasonZh: 语音断句中的韵律线索

questions.prompt: A POS tagger trained on edited news performs poorly on informal posts. Which explanation is plausible?
options: The only possible reason is a smaller label font.
Good news performance guarantees identical performance in every domain.
The posts contain different spelling, vocabulary, and syntactic patterns.
POS categories cannot be assigned to informal language.
questions.explanationZh: 正式语料、社交媒体和生物医学文本的分布可不同。WSJ、社交语料和 GENIA 等资源支持各自场景的评估，应核对目标领域。
distractorsZh: 排版不是统计模型失配的核心解释。
领域偏移会影响泛化。
口语和社交语言也可以进行词性标注。

questions.prompt: Why might character-level features help a POS tagger label a rare word?
options: Character features guarantee the word has only one possible POS.
They reveal the writer's personality label directly.
Prefixes, suffixes, and internal spelling patterns can provide morphological clues.
They replace the need for every contextual clue.
questions.explanationZh: 罕见词或未登录词的整词统计较弱，字符及形态线索可补充信息；上下文仍可能决定歧义词的实际词性。
distractorsZh: 同一形态可能对应多个词性。
词性特征不直接给出人格标签。
上下文仍然重要。

refs.reasonZh: 稀有词的字符与形态特征
稀有词的字符与形态特征

questions.prompt: A chunker considers the predicted labels of nearby tokens when selecting a noun-phrase span. Why can this help?
options: It changes noun phrases into named-entity categories.
It can favor coherent label sequences and phrase boundaries.
It forces every sentence into one noun phrase.
It makes token order irrelevant.
questions.explanationZh: 局部词汇、POS 与上下文特征可以结合前序 chunk 标签或全局结构，让边界更一致。浅层解析识别短语块，不必构建完整句法树。
distractorsZh: 短语类别与实体类型是不同标注目标。
句子可包含多个不同短语块。
标签依赖建立在序列位置之上。

refs.reasonZh: 词组边界与标签一致性
词组边界与标签一致性

questions.prompt: A system correctly tags every token's POS but groups a preposition into the wrong noun phrase. Which evaluation is needed to detect this error?
options: Only checking whether words are spelled correctly.
Only measuring the number of tokens.
Only evaluating document sentiment.
Chunk-span evaluation in addition to token-level POS accuracy.
questions.explanationZh: 正确词性并不保证正确短语分块；词元级准确率与跨度级精确率、召回率和 F1 衡量不同输出结构。
distractorsZh: 拼写检查不能检验短语边界。
词数不评价分组是否正确。
文档情绪与短语边界不直接相同。

questions.prompt: Which annotation is an example of POS tagging rather than named entity recognition?
options: Assigning positive or negative sentiment to a review
Assigning PERSON and ORGANIZATION labels to name spans
Linking 'she' to a previously mentioned person
Assigning noun, verb, and adjective labels to words in context
questions.explanationZh: POS tagging 标注词在上下文中的语法类别。第 220 页给出 PRP、VBZ、NNS 等标签；这些标签与 NER 的 PERSON、ORGANIZATION 是不同层面的信息。
distractorsZh: 这是情感极性判断。
这是命名实体识别的输出。
这是指代消解。

terms.zh: 名词 / 动词 / 形容词

refs.reasonZh: She sells seashells... 的逐词词性标签。

questions.prompt: In 'on my back', what is the POS tag of 'back'?
options: NN (noun)
JJ (adjective)
VB (verb)
RB (adverb)
questions.explanationZh: 第 220 页明确标出 on my back 中的 back 为 NN。相同词形在 the back door 中为 JJ，在 win the voters back 中为 RB，在 to back the bill 中为 VB，说明词性依赖用法。
distractorsZh: JJ 对应讲义的 the back door 用法。
VB 对应 to back the bill 的用法。
RB 对应 win the voters back 的用法。

terms.zh: 单数或不可数名词标签

refs.reasonZh: back 的四种词性对照例子。

questions.prompt: In 'She will can the peaches', assume 'can' means 'preserve in cans'. What is the role of 'can' in this sentence?
options: An adjective modifying peaches
A noun naming a container
A lexical verb following the modal will
A pronoun referring to She
questions.explanationZh: can 表示‘把桃子装罐保存’，在情态助动词 will 后用实义动词原形。这里的句法和词义共同确定其动词用法。
distractorsZh: 本句的 can 不是修饰 peaches 的形容词。
can 可以在别处作名词，但在这里不是。
can 不是代词。

questions.prompt: Which feature set captures a word's identity, surrounding words, and internal structure for POS tagging?
options: Positive, negative, and neutral sentiment categories
Lexical, contextual, and morphological information
PERSON, ORGANIZATION, and LOCATION entity categories
Openness, conscientiousness, and extraversion scores
questions.explanationZh: 表 2.8 列出 Lexical、Contextual、Morphological 等特征。词本身、邻词上下文和形态信息都能为词性判断提供线索。Mock Q21 给定答案为 Lemmatization。
distractorsZh: 这些是情感极性类别，不是该表的词性特征组。
这些是 NER 的典型实体类别，不是表 2.8 列出的特征组。
这些是人格维度，不是该 POS 方法表的特征列。

refs.reasonZh: 表 2.8 的 POS 方法特征列。

questions.prompt: A POS tagger labels 190 of 200 evaluated tokens correctly. Under token accuracy, what is its score?
questions.explanationZh: Token accuracy = 正确标注 token 数 / 评估 token 总数 = 190/200 = 95%。比较不同系统时，还需核对测试集和标签集。
distractorsZh: 5% 是这里的错误比例，不是准确率。
准确率不会因正确数为 190 就等于 190%。
总 token 数不是百分比结果。

refs.reasonZh: 表 2.9 的 POS 结果和 Acc. 指标；190/200 为自编计算。

questions.prompt: Why is text chunking also called shallow parsing?
options: It always produces a complete semantic knowledge graph.
It groups words into phrases without requiring a full deep syntactic analysis.
It discards every syntactic grouping.
It translates each word into another language.
questions.explanationZh: 文本组块识别名词短语、动词短语等局部结构，通常不要求构建完整的深层句法树。第 223 页直接给出 shallow parsing 和 grouping of words in chunks 的说明。
distractorsZh: 完整语义知识图谱超出了浅层句法组块。
组块恰恰要增加短语层面的结构。
翻译不是 chunking 的定义。

refs.reasonZh: 文本组块的定义与 shallow parsing 别名。

questions.prompt: For 'The bright student solved the puzzle', which bracketed span is a straightforward noun phrase chunk?
options: [student solved the]
[solved the]
[The bright student]
[bright student solved]
questions.explanationZh: The bright student 由限定词、形容词和中心名词构成完整的名词短语。其余候选跨越主语与谓语边界，或只截取了不完整的片段。
distractorsZh: 跨过主语与谓语边界。
solved 是谓语动词，the 是后续名词短语的开头。
包含谓语 solved，不是所问的简单名词短语。

refs.reasonZh: 将相邻词组织为短语组块的定义，题中句子为自编。

questions.prompt: Which task produces grammatical-category labels that a chunker can use to identify phrase boundaries?
options: Sarcasm detection
POS tagging
Personality recognition
Aspect sentiment classification
questions.explanationZh: 讲义的处理顺序是 POS tagging → text chunking。词性序列提供语法线索，帮助组块器确定短语边界。
distractorsZh: 讽刺识别不是该页所指的前置步骤。
人格识别属于更后面的语用层任务。
方面情感分类不是该页描述的直接前置步骤。

refs.reasonZh: 文字明确说明 chunking follows POS tagging。
行李箱图中 POS tagging 与 text chunking 的位置。

questions.prompt: Which benchmark is commonly used to evaluate text chunking?
options: SemCor
LIWC
LexNorm1.1
CoNLL2000
questions.explanationZh: 表 2.11 的文本组块结果反复使用 CoNLL2000，指标通常为 F1。Mock Q25 的资源答案为 Penn Treebank。
distractorsZh: SemCor 在讲义中列作词义消歧数据集。
LIWC 不是该组块结果表反复使用的基准。
LexNorm1.1 对应微文本规范化资源。

refs.reasonZh: 右侧表 2.11 的 Dataset 列。

questions.prompt: A chunker models transitions between hidden chunk labels and emissions of observed words. Which model matches this description?
options: A hidden Markov model (HMM)
A linear-chain CRF that directly models the conditional label distribution
A k-means model clustering bag-of-words vectors
An independent token classifier with no label-transition model
questions.explanationZh: Hidden states、transitions、emissions 对应 HMM 的隐藏状态、状态转移和观测发射。组块标签可作为隐状态，词序列作为观测。

独立 token 分类忽略了题干明确建模的标签转移。

refs.reasonZh: 文本组块方法及序列上下文特征的比较背景；HMM 的指定模型来自 Mock Quiz Q23。

questions.prompt: How can phrase chunking support a later named-entity recognizer?
options: By proving that every noun phrase is a person name
By replacing every word with its sentiment score
By eliminating the need to determine entity boundaries
By providing grouped spans that may serve as useful entity candidates
questions.explanationZh: 组块可为 NER 提供候选跨度和局部结构，例如把多词名字作为整体分析。NER 随后判断这些跨度是否为实体，并确定实体类型。
distractorsZh: 名词短语可能指普通事物，不一定是人名。
情感分数不是短语组块的输出。
实体边界仍需确定，chunk 边界也不保证就是实体边界。

refs.reasonZh: NER 标签展示实体跨度，与一般组块作对照。

questions.prompt: What is the common lemma of 'am', 'are', and 'is'?

be
amareis
being
questions.explanationZh: 词形还原把屈折形式映射到词典词条形。am、are、is 的共同 lemma 是 be。

把词拼接起来不是词形还原。

refs.reasonZh: am/are/is → be 及词典 headword 定义。

questions.prompt: How does lemmatization differ from stemming?

Stemming always returns a valid dictionary word, but lemmatization never does.

速度受实现和模型影响，不构成概念定义。
恰恰是 stemming 的输出可能不是有效词条。

refs.reasonZh: 词干提取与 automat 示例。
democrat 词族的两种处理结果对照。

questions.prompt: Why can aggressive suffix stripping harm sentiment analysis?
options: Removing more characters always preserves meaning better.
Every suffix is semantically empty in every language.
Sentiment depends only on word length.
It may merge forms with different meanings or connotations.
questions.explanationZh: 形式相似并不保证意义相同。过度去后缀可能把不同词义或情感内涵合并，因此归一化强度应结合下游目标。

A lemma is always the shortest possible character substring.
Inflection changes grammatical form, while derivation can create a different lexical item.
questions.explanationZh: 屈折形式通常对应同一词元；派生可改变词性或词汇意义。词干算法可能把相关词压到共同片段，而词元化往往需要词性和词典信息。
distractorsZh: 相关意义不代表同一词性或词元。
相同前缀不足以决定词元。
词元不是最短字符串定义。

questions.prompt: A stemmer has a suffix-removal rule that applies only when a morphological condition is satisfied. What should it do when that condition fails?
options: Leave that rule unapplied, even if the suffix text matches.
Apply every suffix rule simultaneously without ordering.
Remove the suffix whenever its letters match.
Discard the entire token.
questions.explanationZh: 规则词干器不仅匹配字符，还可能检验词干结构条件；规则的优先级、最长后缀和分阶段处理会影响结果。
distractorsZh: 阶段和次序可避免冲突。
字符匹配只是条件之一。
条件失败不要求删除整个词。

questions.prompt: A model converts an inflected character sequence into a lemma character sequence. Which formulation fits this operation?
options: Sequence transduction.
Sentence boundary detection alone.
Document-level personality classification.
Entity linking without any word-form transformation.
questions.explanationZh: 词元化可以建模为字符序列到字符序列的转换，也可采用规则、编辑脚本、统计转换与神经转换；上下文和形态标签帮助选择正确输出。
distractorsZh: 断句只预测句界。
人格分类的输出不是词元字符序列。
实体链接映射实体标识，目标不同。

questions.prompt: You want multilingual examples of inflected forms paired with lemmas and morphological information. Which resource family is most relevant?
options: Only a database of geographic coordinates.
Only an image-only facial-expression dataset.
Only a movie-review polarity lexicon.
Morphological resources such as UniMorph and lemmatization shared-task data.
questions.explanationZh: UniMorph、Universal Dependencies 以及 SIGMORPHON 等资源可支撑形态和词元相关研究；具体字段、语言和任务版本仍需检查。
distractorsZh: 地理坐标不是词形标注。
图像表情数据不提供词元序列监督。
情感词典通常不提供所需形态配对。

questions.prompt: A report gives average lemmatization accuracy over many languages. What should be inspected before concluding that the system works equally well on all of them?
options: Only the number of model layers.
Only whether the average is printed with two decimal places.
Only the highest single-language score.
Per-language results and the averaging scheme.
questions.explanationZh: 多语言平均值可能掩盖形态复杂度、数据量和领域带来的语言间差异。宏平均和按样本加权平均也有不同含义。
distractorsZh: 层数不能替代细分评估。
小数位不说明各语言表现。
最高值不能代表所有语言。

questions.prompt: The written word 'tear' can refer to liquid from an eye or to ripping something. What information is most useful for selecting the intended meaning in a sentence?
options: Its surrounding syntactic and semantic context.
A fixed rule assigning the most emotional meaning everywhere.
Its spelling alone, because spelling must uniquely determine sense.
The number of letters alone.
questions.explanationZh: 同形形式可能对应不同词义甚至不同发音。上下文、词性和搭配为消歧提供线索；仅凭拼写无法总是唯一确定意义。
distractorsZh: 固定情绪偏好忽略语境。
同形异义正说明拼写不能唯一确定词义。
词长不能区分同形词义。

questions.prompt: A WSD algorithm compares dictionary definitions with the target word's context and selects the sense with greatest overlap. Which approach is this?
options: A Lesk-style knowledge-based method.
A personality classifier using questionnaire scores.
A sentence-boundary heuristic using periods only.
A pure character edit-distance normalizer.
questions.explanationZh: Lesk 类方法利用词义释义与语境的重叠，属于知识驱动的词义消歧。释义为候选义提供外部语义信息。
distractorsZh: 人格分数不提供词义释义重叠。
句界检测不选择词义。
编辑距离比较字符串形式，不比较词义释义。

questions.prompt: Why can graph ranking help choose senses for several words in the same context?
options: It requires the words to have identical spelling.
It removes all semantic relations before ranking.
It can favor senses connected coherently in a lexical knowledge graph.
It guarantees every word has exactly one dictionary sense.
questions.explanationZh: 图式方法将候选义及其关系组织为图，利用连通性或 PageRank 类排序寻找语境中相互协调的解释。
distractorsZh: 相关词不必同形。
关系正是图排序的重要输入。
词义数量由词汇资源决定，并不被算法强制为一。

questions.prompt: A team has sense definitions but no labeled example sentences. What is missing for straightforward supervised WSD training?
options: A requirement that all definitions have the same length.
A guarantee that the dictionary contains no ambiguous entries.
Any distinction between words and characters.
Examples mapping word occurrences in context to gold sense labels.
questions.explanationZh: WordNet、FrameNet、BabelNet 等提供不同类型的词义或关系知识；SemCor 等提供带词义标注的实例。监督训练需要实例到标签的对应，而不仅是候选义清单。
distractorsZh: 释义等长不是监督条件。
词典记录歧义是正常且必要的。
词与字符区分不能代替监督实例。

refs.reasonZh: 消歧语料与词义知识库

questions.prompt: What is a potential benefit of combining a contextual neural encoder with a lexical knowledge graph for WSD?
options: Adding a graph guarantees perfect accuracy on unseen domains.
The encoder supplies usage context while the graph supplies explicit sense relations.
The combination eliminates the need to define candidate senses.
Both components must contain exactly the same information.
questions.explanationZh: 上下文表示与显式词义知识可互补，形成混合方法。知识资源的覆盖范围、领域适配和融合方式仍影响效果。
distractorsZh: 混合设计并不保证跨域完美。
仍需明确要选择的词义集合或输出形式。
互补性正来自信息来源不同。

questions.prompt: A translation system chooses the financial meaning of 'bank' in a sentence about a river. What can a WSD component directly improve?
options: The physical speed of the speaker's voice.
The number of pages in the source document.
The document's font size.
The selection of the context-appropriate meaning before translation.
questions.explanationZh: 错误词义会传给翻译、检索和情感分析等下游任务。显式消歧可提供特征、解析结果或解释依据，但仍需测试整体收益。
distractorsZh: 词义选择不直接改变语音速度。
页数不解决语义歧义。
排版不决定词义。

questions.prompt: In 'Maya works at Acme Corporation', which output is a named-entity annotation?
options: Maya: first sentence; Acme Corporation: second sentence
Maya: verb; Acme Corporation: adverb
Maya: positive; Acme Corporation: negative
Maya: PERSON; Acme Corporation: ORGANIZATION
questions.explanationZh: NER 识别文本中的实体跨度并赋予类别。题中 Maya 是人名，Acme Corporation 是机构名。这些实体类别不同于词性、情感或句子编号。
distractorsZh: 这不是句子边界的合理输出，也不是 NER。
这是词性标签，不是实体类别。
这是情感标签，且题句不支持这种极性判断。

refs.reasonZh: NER 标注与资源的概览。
PER、LOC 等实体标签与跨度示例。

questions.prompt: What does CRF stand for in sequence-labeling NER?
options: A hidden Markov model with generative transition and emission probabilities
A model that independently labels each token without label dependencies
Conditional Random Field
An unsupervised clustering model for grouping context vectors
questions.explanationZh: CRF 是 Conditional Random Field（条件随机场），可建模序列标签之间的依赖。讲义的 NER 技术表包含 LSTM-CRF。
distractorsZh: 这是 HMM 的描述，不是 CRF 的全称或同一概率建模方式。
独立分类器不等于 CRF；CRF 可以建模标签间依赖。
这是语境聚类的描述，不是 CRF。

refs.reasonZh: 代表性 NER 技术表含 LSTM-CRF；模型名称与用途见 Mock Quiz Q43。

questions.prompt: Which benchmark is used for named-entity recognition?
options: SIGMORPHON 2019

CoNLL-2003
questions.explanationZh: CoNLL-2003 对应命名实体识别；CoNLL-2000 对应文本组块。年份是区分这两个评测基准的关键信息。

questions.prompt: Using BIO tags, how should the two-token person name 'Ada Lovelace' be marked when it forms one complete entity span?
options: B-PER, B-PER
B-PER, I-PER
I-PER, B-PER

questions.prompt: Under exact-match entity evaluation, a model predicts 10 entities, 8 are correct, and the gold set contains 12 entities. What is F1?
options: Approximately 0.727
questions.explanationZh: Precision = 8/10 = 0.8，Recall = 8/12 ≈ 0.667，F1 = 2PR/(P+R) = 16/22 ≈ 0.727。这里按完整实体的精确匹配计分。
distractorsZh: 0.8 是 precision，不是 F1。

既有误报也有漏报，不可能 F1 为 1。

refs.reasonZh: NER 技术表的 F1 评估背景；公式对应 Mock Quiz Q46，数字自编。

questions.prompt: How can named-entity recognition support anaphora resolution and opinion-target detection?
options: NER makes sentence context irrelevant.
NER removes every reference to people from a document.
Recognized entities can help identify what a later referring expression or opinion is about.
NER proves that all pronouns refer to the nearest noun.
questions.explanationZh: 实体的类型和跨度可帮助判断后续指代表达的所指，进而确定评论谈论的方面或意见对象。讲义将这条依赖写为 NER → anaphora resolution → opinion targets。
distractorsZh: 实体类别及其所指常常依赖上下文。
NER 的目标是识别而非一律删除人名。
最近名词启发式可能失败，NER 也不能证明此绝对规则。

refs.reasonZh: NER → anaphora resolution → aspects/opinion targets 的明确说明。

questions.prompt: Under BIOES tagging, how should a three-token entity be labeled when it is one complete span?
options: B, I, E
I, O, I
B, B, B
S, S, S
questions.explanationZh: B 表示开头，I 表示内部，E 表示结尾，S 表示独立单词实体，O 表示实体外部。三词完整跨度因此为 B-I-E。
distractorsZh: O 会把中间词排除在实体之外。
三个 B 表示三个新跨度开头。
三个 S 表示三个独立单词实体。

questions.prompt: A text span names an organization that contains a location name inside it. Why might a single flat BIO sequence be insufficient?
options: BIO requires every entity to contain exactly one word.
Organizations and locations can never overlap in text.
It normally assigns one label per token and cannot directly express all overlapping nested spans.
Nested entities remove the need to predict boundaries.
questions.explanationZh: 嵌套 NER 需要同时表达内外层实体，单层标签序列通常不足。多层标注、跨度模型或超图等结构可表示多个层次。
distractorsZh: BIO 可以表示多词实体。
组织名可以包含地名等内层实体。
每层跨度仍需要边界。

questions.prompt: A system asks a language model to complete 'X is a [MASK] entity' and maps 'person' to a label. What is the central idea?
options: Reformulate entity typing as a language-model prediction with a label mapping.
Assume a masked token automatically determines every possible entity boundary.
Require millions of newly labeled examples for the definition of few-shot learning.
Replace entity typing with alphabetical sorting.
questions.explanationZh: 提示方法利用预训练语言模型完成标签词预测，可用于少样本适配。实体跨度发现与类型映射仍需明确设计。
distractorsZh: 边界与类型是相关但不同的步骤。
少样本恰强调有限的任务标注。
排序不进行实体类型推断。

questions.prompt: A table-filling model predicts entity boundaries on some token pairs and relations on others. What is the intended benefit?
options: Represent entities and their relations within a shared structured prediction problem.
Turn every token pair into a separate sentence.
Produce relations without identifying their entity endpoints at any stage.
Treat relation labels as alternative spellings of entity names.
questions.explanationZh: 表填充可让实体跨度与实体间关系共享结构和特征，从而进行联合抽取。联合建模并非取消实体识别，而是使两个目标协同。
distractorsZh: 词对结构不改变句子单位定义。
关系端点仍需识别。
关系表示实体间联系，不是名称拼写。

questions.prompt: A recognizer needs terminology for diseases and medications. Which resource choice best matches this need?
options: Only an informal-spelling normalization benchmark.
Only a geographic gazetteer such as GeoNames.
Only a personality-trait questionnaire.
Medical resources such as UMLS, SNOMED CT, or DrugBank.
questions.explanationZh: 医学资源提供疾病、药物等领域知识；地理、金融与教育任务也可能选用不同专门知识库。标注语料与知识库分别提供学习实例和概念知识。
distractorsZh: 规范化基准面向不同输出目标。
地名资源不覆盖所需医学术语主干。
人格问卷不提供医学实体知识。

questions.prompt: A system labels 'Washington' as a location but has not chosen which real-world place it denotes. Which problem remains?
options: Whether the string contains any letters.
Whether every named entity is automatically the nearest pronoun's antecedent.
Whether all locations must be people.
Entity disambiguation or linking to the intended referent.
questions.explanationZh: 类型识别回答“属于哪类实体”，具体指向仍可能有歧义。NER 为指代、知识图谱、推荐和对话提供线索，但不独自完成所有语义推断。
distractorsZh: 这不解决名称所指。
指代还需语义和语境。
地点与人物类型不能混为一谈。

refs.reasonZh: 实体识别与实体消歧的界限
实体识别与实体消歧的界限

questions.prompt: A parser extracts GET_ALONG_WITH and HAIR_DRESSER from a sentence rather than retaining only isolated words. Which goal does this illustrate?
options: Extracting only proper names of persons and organizations
Assigning a POS tag independently to each individual token
Extracting meaningful multiword concepts
Reducing every token to a single affix-stripped stem
questions.explanationZh: 概念抽取可以保留多词表达的整体意义。Mock Quiz Q48 用 Sentic Parser 的 get_along_with 与 hair_dresser 作为例子；讲义第 245 页的 GET 组合也显示词与搭配的语义关系。概念比命名实体的范围更广。

questions.prompt: Which property tends to give a term a high inverse document frequency (IDF)?

A term with high frequency in one document, regardless of its document frequency
A term occurring in every document
A term assigned a noun POS tag, regardless of corpus distribution
questions.explanationZh: IDF 衡量词在语料中的稀有程度：出现文档越少，区分性通常越强。TF-IDF 再结合当前文档的词频，为候选关键词评分。
distractorsZh: 这是 TF 相关信息；单凭文档内词频无法确定 IDF。

questions.prompt: Why can removing 'to' from 'flights to London' harm concept extraction?

命名不决定性能。

questions.prompt: In 'Nora bought a laptop. It was very light', which expression is the antecedent of 'It'?

a laptop
bought

bought是动作词，不是此处的先行词。

存在歧义不等于没有先行词。

questions.prompt: Why is named entity recognition not sufficient to resolve every anaphoric reference?

An antecedent can be a common noun phrase, and choosing it requires context

questions.prompt: The notebook would not fit into the envelope because it was too wide. Which referent for 'it' best explains the failed fit?

The envelope, solely because it is the nearest noun
Both objects must be the referent at the same time

questions.prompt: Why can gender and number agreement narrow antecedent candidates without always resolving a pronoun uniquely?

questions.explanationZh: 形态一致性是筛选条件，而不是唯一性保证。多个候选兼容时，事件语义、常识、语篇焦点等继续发挥作用。

距离启发式可能与语义冲突。

questions.prompt: A language allows a subject to be omitted when it is recoverable from context. What must a zero-pronoun resolver infer?

Only the pronunciation of the missing punctuation.
A new word sense for every visible noun.
That the sentence contains no participant.

词义选择不是本题核心。
省略不意味着事件没有参与者。

questions.prompt: Which combination is suitable for developing a coreference system?

Only unlabeled spelling variants, with no mention structure.

questions.prompt: What is a limitation of resolving every mention pair independently?

distractorsZh: 同一实体簇应保持身份一致。
一个实体通常可有多次提及。
独立预测未必保证传递一致性。

questions.prompt: A coreference report defines its score as the mean of MUC, B³, and CEAF scores. Why is the metric definition important?

A higher average proves every document's clusters are perfect.
These metrics assess clustering in different ways, so the reported average is not ordinary token accuracy.
The mean must equal the number of correctly spelled tokens.
questions.explanationZh: 共指评价关注提及簇结构；MUC、B³、CEAF 的计算角度不同。比较时应核对变体、提及设置及平均方式。
distractorsZh: 它们是共指评价指标。
平均分可掩盖局部错误。
拼写 token 数与共指簇评价不同。

refs.reasonZh: 共指评价中的组合指标

questions.prompt: Which distinction is the direct target of subjectivity detection?
options: Literal word senses versus metaphorical word senses
References to the same entity versus different entities
Objective statements versus subjective statements
Positive opinions versus negative opinions
questions.explanationZh: 255页将主观性检测表述为objective与subjective的二分类。正面和负面意见都属于主观表达，极性进一步区分意见的方向。
distractorsZh: 这是词义与隐喻相关的区分。
这是共指关系相关的区分。
这是极性区别；正面与负面意见都可能是主观的。

questions.prompt: A reviewer strongly likes a film's acting but strongly dislikes its plot. What best describes this combined attitude?

Objectivity, because two aspects are mentioned

questions.explanationZh: 255页把positivity和negativity画成两个独立方向。两者都高对应ambivalence；两者都低才接近neutral。把正负相加为零会丢掉这种区别。
distractorsZh: 情感并存不等于没有情感。
提到多个方面不使意见自动变客观。
矛盾情感仍然包含情感。

refs.reasonZh: 正向与负向情感二维图

questions.prompt: A feature extractor counts adjectives, adverbs, and modal verbs. Which type of feature is it most directly using?

Edit distances between normalized word forms
POS-based features
questions.explanationZh: 形容词、副词、情态动词属于词性类别，因此这里使用POS-based features。它们可帮助识别评价、强调和态度表达，亦可与TF-IDF等特征结合。
distractorsZh: TF-IDF直接加权词频，不直接标出形容词、副词等类别。
情感分值并非这里计数的词性类别。
编辑距离比较字符串变换，不是词性特征。

refs.reasonZh: 主观性检测技术趋势；本题POS解释见Mock Q59

questions.prompt: For the subjective class, precision is 0.80 and recall is 0.50. What is F1, rounded to two decimal places?

questions.prompt: What distinguishes the MPQA Subjectivity Lexicon from a corpus of individually labeled documents?
